sets.name_vi: Cửa Sông & Bãi Cọc Bạch Đằng (938 · 981 · 1288)
sets.terrain_and_architecture_dna: Towering jagged dark-grey Tràng Kênh limestone karst cliffs flanking the wide churning Bạch Đằng tidal estuary in northern Vietnam, firm grey clay riverbeds holding staggered rows of massive sharpened ironwood stakes angled 75 degrees upstream against foaming 4-meter ebb-tide swells, crisp optical clarity on 35mm anamorphic film.
sets.atmosphere_lock: Clear-air 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T optical clarity with dramatic directional golden-amber dawn rays breaking through storm clouds and warm Caravaggio fire-raft chiaroscuro reflecting off surging olive-brown tidal water; zero blanket fog.
recommended_lens_pairings: 24mm Wide Establishing (estuary & Tràng Kênh karst cliffs)
35mm Low-Angle Hero (commander on galley prow above surging waves)
85mm Tight Action Macro (ironwood stake tip ripping oak hull planks)
anti_anachronism_bans: no modern steel bridges, cargo ships, or concrete riverbanks
no blanket dense fog obscuring stakes or warships
no text or labels on water or banners

sets.name_vi: Phòng Tuyến Sông Như Nguyệt – Lũy Tre Gai (1077 · 1285)

sets.atmosphere_lock: Crisp 35mm optical contrast clashing warm 2200K iron watchtower braziers against cool 5600K pre-dawn river light with razor-sharp detail on wet red earth, bamboo thorns, and rushing water.
recommended_lens_pairings: 24mm Elevated Wide Establishing (100km winding river rampart)
50mm Medium OTS (sentinel behind bamboo parapet facing northern camp)
85mm Tight Action Macro (sharpened bamboo caltrops and iron spearheads)
anti_anachronism_bans: no modern concrete dikes, barbed steel wire, or searchlights
no gunpowder artillery batteries
no text or calligraphy on temple walls
